purpose: Row-level evidence that replaces the 7bbd69b gate's BLOCKED_RUNTIME_ROW_NOT_READ status with direct Runtime row comparisons. It does not mint identities and does not publish an overlay.

source_runtime.runtime_branch_head_subject: qa(core20k): establish fail-closed dual AI review pilot for 30 matched KUs
source_runtime.retrieval_method: git fetch from origin (https) + git show to local files; gzip decompressed locally. No GitHub push, no main modification, no Runtime/SRS/learning-record write.

runtime_data_structure.headword_row: [rank (int), lemma (string), pos_raw (string, headword-level display summary), ipa (string), kus (list)]
runtime_data_structure.identity_fields_present: rank, lemma, pos_raw, ipa, ku_id, kind, glosses, playable.
runtime_data_structure.identity_fields_absent: No headword_id field and no sense_id field anywhere in the decompressed Runtime (sense_id key occurrences: 0). Sense identity in Runtime is therefore the KU row itself (ku_id of a kind=sense row).
runtime_data_structure.ku_id_pattern: w_<4-digit legacy index>_<lemma>_ku<NN>, where the 4-digit index is NOT the rank (e.g. rank 1 'out' carries w_0055; rank 108 'person' carries w_0266). Rank and w_ index must never be conflated.
runtime_data_structure.orphans_relevance: Neither orphan (dem, nome) is one of the six headwords; they do not affect this mapping.

comparison.gloss_note: English gloss is a word-order paraphrase (individual human being vs human individual); Chinese gloss is character-exact. Same sense, not a different sense.
comparison.ipa_note: Pack /ˈpɝː.sən/ vs Runtime /pˈɝsən/: same segments, stress-mark placement and length-mark convention differ only.
comparison.sibling_rows_same_gloss_note: Gloss text alone does not identify the row: sibling rows under the same headword share gloss text with different kinds (e.g. morphology/grammar/collocation rows). Identification here rests on the verbatim ku_id string plus kind=sense, not on gloss text alone.

The teaching line's alternative-answer policy for time (B217 OPEN item) must cover 时长-inclusive answers.

comparison.gloss_note: Runtime English gloss abbreviates the dictionary sense (in this place vs legacy at or to this place); Chinese gloss is character-exact. The teaching example 'Please come here' is directional, and standard dictionary treatment unifies in/at/to this place as one sense, but the Runtime row text itself does not spell out the directional side. Recorded as a gloss-completeness note, not an identity conflict: the ku_id, rank, lemma, POS, kind, and Chinese gloss all match, and no separate directional KU row exists under here (ku02 is 'at this point', temporal). If the teaching line requires the directional side to be separately registered, that is a Runtime gloss question for the Runtime owner, not a reason to invent a sense ID here.
